#Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for Head of Personnel (HoP)
[italic]Below outlines expectations and permissions granted to a HoP given the current alert level:[/italic]
[bold][color=green] Code Green [/color][/bold]
[bold]1.[/bold] The HoP may utilize paperwork at their own discretion. It is expected during major station emergencies, expediency should be prioritized.
[bold]2.[/bold] The HoP may [bold]not[/bold] transfer any personnel to another Department without authorization from the relevant [color=#1b67a5]Head of Staff[/color]. Given no [color=#1b67a5]Head of Staff[/color] is present, HoP may make a decision of their own judgment. Security is the exception as authorization from an individual with [color=#cb0000]Head of Security[/color] level authority is required.
[bold]3.[/bold] The HoP may [bold]not[/bold] give any personnel command level access without authorization from the [color=#1b67a5]Captain[/color].
[bold]4.[/bold] The HoP must respond to personnel with a legitimate request within ten (10) minutes, either via radio or in person.
[bold]5.[/bold] The HoP is [bold]not[/bold] permitted to perform [color=#cb0000]Security[/color] duty. The HoP may only use their Disabler to remove trespassers out of their office or in self defense.
[bold][color=blue] Code Blue [/color][/bold]
[bold]1.[/bold] All guidelines carry over from Code Green.
[bold][color=RED] Code Red [/color][/bold]
[bold]1.[/bold] All guidelines carry over from Code Blue.
[bold]2.[/bold] The HoP is permitted to collect the Deckard from the Vault for self defense. Once the Code is reduced to Green, the Deckard will be returned to the vault when deemed appropriate by the HOP or [color=#cb0000]Head of Security[/color].
